_comment: The music under the promo: a published track, used under its licence, downloaded by fetch-music.mjs into video/public/ (not committed). CC BY asks for the attribution wherever the video is published: render.mjs appends it to every description.txt. volume is the level under the picture (the voice-over halves it while it speaks). To go back to the original procedural bed, delete video/public/music.mp3: render.mjs then uses music.wav from synthesize.mjs.
